title: T-cell receptor repertoire in metastatic colorectal cancer during chemotherapy
description: In this study, we aimed to determine the characteristics and clinical significance of the TCR repertoire in patients with unresectable metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). Overall design: Analysis of TCR sequences from 103 unresectable metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) patient blood samples.
